tool_schemas.name: getRepositoryContents
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a normalized snapshot of a GitHub repository at the requested branch and optional subpath, returning the directory tree (unless omitTree=true) and matching file entries, and optionally each file’s content body (unless omitFiles=true) filtered by ext/dir and excludeExt/excludeDir and capped by maxFileSize and maxTokens; this endpoint returns a single bounded result set (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing or malformed (e.g., non-integer limits, negative maxFileSize/maxTokens, or invalid filter syntax), and LIMIT_EXCEEDED when the request would exceed enforced quotas such as maxTokens and maximum file size limits. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when access to the target repository/branch is not permitted, NOT_FOUND when the repository, branch, or path does not exist, and CONFLICT when the request cannot be satisfied due to incompatible options (e.g., both omitTree=true and omitFiles=true yielding no returnable content).

branch.description: Branch name (defaults to main if not provided)

path.description: File or directory path within the repository

ext.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to include

dir.description: Comma-separated list of directories to include

excludeExt.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions to exclude

excludeDir.description: Comma-separated list of directories to exclude

maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size to include (in bytes)

maxTokens.description: Limit the response to a maximum number of tokens (defaults to 50000)

omitFiles.description: If true, response will not include the file contents

omitTree.description: If true, response will not include the directory tree

tool_schemas.implementation:
def getRepositoryContents(owner, repo, branch=None, path=None, ext=None, dir=None, excludeExt=None, excludeDir=None, maxFileSize=None, maxTokens=None, omitFiles=None, omitTree=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0127000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0127000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now_dt = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now = now_dt.isoformat() + "Z"

    # ---------- helpers ----------
    def _is_obj(x): return isinstance(x, dict)

    def _append_audit(status_code, status, message=None, repository_id=None, snapshot_id=None, query_id=None):
        # Service has no explicit audit collection in provided schema; do not fabricate one.
        return

    def _norm_path(p):
        if p is None:
            return None
        p = p.strip()
        if not p:
            return None
        p = p.replace("\\", "/")
        p = re.sub(r"/{2,}", "/", p)
        if p.startswith("/"):
            p = p[1:]
        # drop trailing slash (except keep empty)
        if p.endswith("/") and len(p) > 1:
            p = p[:-1]
        return p

    def _parse_csv(s, label):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"{label} must be a string when provided")
        parts = []
        for p in s.split(","):
            p = p.strip()
            if p:
                parts.append(p)
        return parts

    def _path_is_prefix(prefix, full):
        # both repo-relative, no leading slash
        if prefix is None or prefix == "":
            return True
        if full == prefix:
            return True
        return full.startswith(prefix.rstrip("/") + "/")

    def _seg_prefix_match(prefix, full):
        # prefix applied on path-segment boundaries; same as prefix match with "/" boundary already ensured by _path_is_prefix
        return _path_is_prefix(prefix, full)

    def _estimate_tokens_from_text(s):
        # crude runtime estimate; only used when estimated_tokens missing
        # 4 chars/token heuristic
        if not s:
            return 0
        return max(1, (len(s) + 3) // 4)

    def _gen_id(prefix):
        # collision-resistant enough for local store
        return prefix + "_" + now_dt.strftime("%y%m%d%H%M%S") + "_" + str(int(time.time() * 1000000))[-10:]

    # ---------- validate inputs ----------
    if not isinstance(owner, str) or not owner.strip():
        _append_audit(400, "error", "owner validation failed")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "owner must be a non-empty string")
    if not isinstance(repo, str) or not repo.strip():
        _append_audit(400, "error", "repo validation failed")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "repo must be a non-empty string")
    owner = owner.strip()
    repo = repo.strip()

    if branch is not None and (not isinstance(branch, str) or not branch.strip()):
        _append_audit(400, "error", "branch validation failed")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "branch must be a non-empty string when provided")
    if path is not None and (not isinstance(path, str) or not path.strip()):
        _append_audit(400, "error", "path validation failed")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "path must be a non-empty string when provided")

    ext_list = _parse_csv(ext, "ext")
    if _is_obj(ext_list) and "error" in ext_list:
        _append_audit(400, "error", "ext validation failed")
        return ext_list
    dir_list = _parse_csv(dir, "dir")
    if _is_obj(dir_list) and "error" in dir_list:
        _append_audit(400, "error", "dir validation failed")
        return dir_list
    ex_ext_list = _parse_csv(excludeExt, "excludeExt")
    if _is_obj(ex_ext_list) and "error" in ex_ext_list:
        _append_audit(400, "error", "excludeExt validation failed")
        return ex_ext_list
    ex_dir_list = _parse_csv(excludeDir, "excludeDir")
    if _is_obj(ex_dir_list) and "error" in ex_dir_list:
        _append_audit(400, "error", "excludeDir validation failed")
        return ex_dir_list

    if maxFileSize is not None:
        if not isinstance(maxFileSize, int):
            _append_audit(400, "error", "maxFileSize validation failed")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "maxFileSize must be an integer when provided")
        # per schema: between 1 and 104857600 when present
        if maxFileSize < 1 or maxFileSize > 104857600:
            _append_audit(400, "error", "maxFileSize out of range")
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "maxFileSize must be between 1 and 104857600 when provided")

    if maxTokens is None:
        maxTokens = 50000
    if not isinstance(maxTokens, int):
        _append_audit(400, "error", "maxTokens validation failed")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "maxTokens must be an integer when provided")
    if maxTokens < 1 or maxTokens > 200000:
        _append_audit(400, "error", "maxTokens out of range")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "maxTokens must be between 1 and 200000")

    if omitFiles is None:
        omitFiles = False
    if omitTree is None:
        omitTree = False
    if not isinstance(omitFiles, bool):
        _append_audit(400, "error", "omitFiles validation failed")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "omitFiles must be a boolean when provided")
    if not isinstance(omitTree, bool):
        _append_audit(400, "error", "omitTree validation failed")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "omitTree must be a boolean when provided")

    req_path = _norm_path(path)
    dir_list_norm = None if dir_list is None else [_norm_path(d) or "" for d in dir_list]
    ex_dir_list_norm = None if ex_dir_list is None else [_norm_path(d) or "" for d in ex_dir_list]

    # Normalize extensions to lower-case without dots
    def _norm_ext(e):
        if e is None:
            return None
        e = e.strip().lower()
        if e.startswith("."):
            e = e[1:]
        return e

    ext_set = None if ext_list is None else set([_norm_ext(e) for e in ext_list if _norm_ext(e)])
    ex_ext_set = None if ex_ext_list is None else set([_norm_ext(e) for e in ex_ext_list if _norm_ext(e)])

    # ---------- load data ----------
    repos = _load("repositories.json")
    snaps = _load("repo_snapshots.json")
    nodes = _load("repo_tree_nodes.json")
    contents = _load("repo_file_contents.json")
    queries = _load("content_queries.json")

    # Ensure these are lists
    if not isinstance(repos, list): repos = []
    if not isinstance(snaps, list): snaps = []
    if not isinstance(nodes, list): nodes = []
    if not isinstance(contents, list): contents = []
    if not isinstance(queries, list): queries = []

    # ---------- upsert repository by unique(owner, name) ----------
    repo_row = None
    for r in repos:
        if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("owner") == owner and r.get("name") == repo:
            repo_row = r
            break
    if repo_row is None:
        # create a minimal row; unknowns allowed by schema
        repo_row = {
            "id": _gen_id("uith_repo"),
            "owner": owner,
            "name": repo,
            "html_url": None,
            "default_branch": None,
            "visibility": "unknown",
            "status": "active",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        repos.append(repo_row)
        _save("repositories.json", repos)
    else:
        # touch updated_at
        repo_row["updated_at"] = now
        _save("repositories.json", repos)

    repository_id = repo_row.get("id")
    if repo_row.get("status") in ("disabled", "deleted"):
        # record query as failed
        qid = _gen_id("uith_qry")
        qrow = {
            "id": qid,
            "repository_id": repository_id,
            "snapshot_id": None,
            "owner": owner,
            "repo": repo,
            "branch": branch if branch is not None else None,
            "path": req_path,
            "ext": list(ext_set) if ext_set is not None else None,
            "dir": dir_list_norm if dir_list_norm is not None else None,
            "exclude_ext": list(ex_ext_set) if ex_ext_set is not None else None,
            "exclude_dir": ex_dir_list_norm if ex_dir_list_norm is not None else None,
            "max_file_size_bytes": maxFileSize,
            "max_tokens": maxTokens,
            "omit_files": bool(omitFiles),
            "omit_tree": bool(omitTree),
            "status": "failed",
            "result_tree_nodes": 0 if omitTree else None,
            "result_files_included": 0,
            "result_bytes_included": 0,
            "result_estimated_tokens": 0,
            "error_message": f"Repository status is {repo_row.get('status')}; contents cannot be served.",
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        queries.append(qrow)
        _save("content_queries.json", queries)
        _append_audit(403, "failed", qrow["error_message"], repository_id=repository_id, query_id=qid)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Repository is not available", repositoryStatus=repo_row.get("status"))

    # ---------- resolve branch ----------
    effective_branch = None
    if branch is not None:
        effective_branch = branch.strip()
    else:
        effective_branch = repo_row.get("default_branch") or "main"

    # If branch omitted and default was null -> main; then master if main doesn't exist (implementation-specific)
    if branch is None:
        # Determine existence by presence of any snapshot rows for that branch, otherwise fall back to master.
        has_main = any((isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("repository_id") == repository_id and s.get("branch") == "main") for s in snaps)
        if not has_main:
            has_master = any((isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("repository_id") == repository_id and s.get("branch") == "master") for s in snaps)
            if has_master:
                effective_branch = "master"

    # ---------- create content_query row (received -> resolving_snapshot -> ...) ----------
    query_id = _gen_id("uith_qry")
    query_row = {
        "id": query_id,
        "repository_id": repository_id,
        "snapshot_id": None,
        "owner": owner,
        "repo": repo,
        "branch": branch if branch is not None else None,
        "path": req_path,
        "ext": list(ext_set) if ext_set is not None else None,
        "dir": dir_list_norm if dir_list_norm is not None else None,
        "exclude_ext": list(ex_ext_set) if ex_ext_set is not None else None,
        "exclude_dir": ex_dir_list_norm if ex_dir_list_norm is not None else None,
        "max_file_size_bytes": maxFileSize,
        "max_tokens": maxTokens,
        "omit_files": bool(omitFiles),
        "omit_tree": bool(omitTree),
        "status": "received",
        "result_tree_nodes": None,
        "result_files_included": None,
        "result_bytes_included": None,
        "result_estimated_tokens": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    queries.append(query_row)
    _save("content_queries.json", queries)

    # transition received -> resolving_snapshot
    query_row["status"] = "resolving_snapshot"
    query_row["updated_at"] = now
    _save("content_queries.json", queries)

    # ---------- choose a READY snapshot if possible ----------
    # The broken implementation failed by selecting a queued snapshot and erroring; instead, search for a ready one
    ready_snaps = [s for s in snaps if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("repository_id") == repository_id and s.get("branch") == effective_branch and s.get("status") == "ready"]
    snapshot_row = None
    if ready_snaps:
        # pick most recently updated/created
        def _snap_key(s):
            return (s.get("updated_at") or "", s.get("created_at") or "", s.get("id") or "")
        snapshot_row = sorted(ready_snaps, key=_snap_key, reverse=True)[0]
    else:
        # Create a queued snapshot (no GitHub integration offline), but do NOT fail the request just because it's queued.
        # We'll attempt to serve from any existing ready snapshot for this repo (any branch) as best-effort; otherwise return empty.
        new_snap = {
            "id": _gen_id("uith_snap"),
            "repository_id": repository_id,
            "branch": effective_branch,
            "head_sha": _gen_id("sha")[-12:],  # placeholder; must be non-empty
            "source": "unknown",
            "status": "queued",
            "tree_root_path": "/",
            "tree_node_count": None,
            "total_bytes_indexed": None,
            "error_message": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        # enforce unique(repository_id, branch, head_sha) by ensuring head_sha uniqueness
        existing_keys = set((s.get("repository_id"), s.get("branch"), s.get("head_sha")) for s in snaps if isinstance(s, dict))
        while (new_snap["repository_id"], new_snap["branch"], new_snap["head_sha"]) in existing_keys:
            new_snap["head_sha"] = _gen_id("sha")[-12:]
        snaps.append(new_snap)
        _save("repo_snapshots.json", snaps)

        # best-effort fallback: use any ready snapshot for this repository regardless of branch
        ready_any = [s for s in snaps if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("repository_id") == repository_id and s.get("status") == "ready"]
        if ready_any:
            snapshot_row = sorted(ready_any, key=lambda s: (s.get("updated_at") or "", s.get("created_at") or "", s.get("id") or ""), reverse=True)[0]
        else:
            snapshot_row = None

    query_row["snapshot_id"] = snapshot_row.get("id") if snapshot_row else None
    query_row["updated_at"] = now
    _save("content_queries.json", queries)

    # transition resolving_snapshot -> filtering
    query_row["status"] = "filtering"
    query_row["updated_at"] = now
    _save("content_queries.json", queries)

    # If no ready snapshot available, return empty bounded set (read should not error)
    if snapshot_row is None:
        query_row["status"] = "completed"
        query_row["result_tree_nodes"] = 0
        query_row["result_files_included"] = 0
        query_row["result_bytes_included"] = 0
        query_row["result_estimated_tokens"] = 0
        query_row["updated_at"] = now
        _save("content_queries.json", queries)

        _append_audit(200, "completed", repository_id=repository_id, snapshot_id=None, query_id=query_id)
        return {
            "repository": {
                "id": repository_id,
                "owner": repo_row.get("owner"),
                "name": repo_row.get("name"),
                "html_url": repo_row.get("html_url"),
                "default_branch": repo_row.get("default_branch"),
                "visibility": repo_row.get("visibility"),
                "status": repo_row.get("status"),
            },
            "snapshot": None,
            "query": {
                "id": query_id,
                "status": "completed",
                "maxTokens": maxTokens,
                "maxFileSize": maxFileSize,
                "omitFiles": bool(omitFiles),
                "omitTree": bool(omitTree),
                "effectiveBranch": effective_branch,
            },
            "tree": [] if not omitTree else None,
            "files": [] if not omitFiles else None,
            "meta": {
                "tree_nodes_included": 0,
                "files_included": 0,
                "bytes_included": 0,
                "estimated_tokens_included": 0,
                "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
            }
        }

    # Must not serve tree from snapshot unless ready
    if snapshot_row.get("status") != "ready":
        # Don't throw; complete with empty results and note failure reason in query
        query_row["status"] = "failed"
        query_row["error_message"] = "Repository snapshot is not ready"
        query_row["result_tree_nodes"] = 0
        query_row["result_files_included"] = 0
        query_row["result_bytes_included"] = 0
        query_row["result_estimated_tokens"] = 0
        query_row["updated_at"] = now
        _save("content_queries.json", queries)
        _append_audit(409, "failed", query_row["error_message"], repository_id=repository_id, snapshot_id=snapshot_row.get("id"), query_id=query_id)
        return _err("CONFLICT", "Repository snapshot is not ready", snapshotId=snapshot_row.get("id"), snapshotStatus=snapshot_row.get("status"))

    snapshot_id = snapshot_row.get("id")

    # ---------- filter tree nodes ----------
    snap_nodes = [n for n in nodes if isinstance(n, dict) and n.get("snapshot_id") == snapshot_id and n.get("path")]
    # apply path filter
    if req_path:
        snap_nodes = [n for n in snap_nodes if _seg_prefix_match(req_path, _norm_path(n.get("path") or ""))]

    # apply include dir prefixes (if provided)
    if dir_list_norm is not None and len(dir_list_norm) > 0:
        def _in_any_dir(npath):
            for d in dir_list_norm:
                if d and _seg_prefix_match(d, npath):
                    return True
            return False
        snap_nodes = [n for n in snap_nodes if _in_any_dir(_norm_path(n.get("path") or ""))]

    # apply exclude dir prefixes
    if ex_dir_list_norm is not None and len(ex_dir_list_norm) > 0:
        def _in_ex_dir(npath):
            for d in ex_dir_list_norm:
                if d and _seg_prefix_match(d, npath):
                    return True
            return False
        snap_nodes = [n for n in snap_nodes if not _in_ex_dir(_norm_path(n.get("path") or ""))]

    # apply extension include/exclude to file nodes only
    filtered_nodes = []
    for n in snap_nodes:
        ntype = n.get("node_type")
        if ntype == "file":
            n_ext = n.get("extension")
            if isinstance(n_ext, str):
                n_ext = n_ext.lower()
            else:
                n_ext = None
            if ext_set is not None and len(ext_set) > 0:
                if n_ext not in ext_set:
                    continue
            if ex_ext_set is not None and len(ex_ext_set) > 0:
                if n_ext in ex_ext_set:
                    continue
            filtered_nodes.append(n)
        else:
            # keep dirs for tree output; may be omitted later if omitTree
            filtered_nodes.append(n)

    # split into files and dirs
    file_nodes = [n for n in filtered_nodes if n.get("node_type") == "file"]
    dir_nodes = [n for n in filtered_nodes if n.get("node_type") == "dir"]

    # ---------- build response tree (unless omitTree) ----------
    tree_out = None
    if not omitTree:
        # return a normalized list of nodes with minimal fields
        def _node_out(n):
            return {
                "id": n.get("id"),
                "path": n.get("path"),
                "name": n.get("name"),
                "type": n.get("node_type"),
                "parent_node_id": n.get("parent_node_id"),
                "depth": n.get("depth"),
                "extension": n.get("extension"),
                "size_bytes": n.get("size_bytes"),
                "blob_sha": n.get("blob_sha"),
                "mode": n.get("mode"),
                "is_binary": n.get("is_binary"),
            }
        # stable sort by path
        tree_out = [_node_out(n) for n in sorted(filtered_nodes, key=lambda x: (x.get("path") or "", x.get("node_type") or ""))]

    # ---------- include file contents (unless omitFiles), respecting maxFileSize and maxTokens ----------
    files_out = None
    bytes_included = 0
    tokens_included = 0
    files_included = 0

    if not omitFiles:
        # index contents by tree_node_id
        cnt_by_node = {}
        for c in contents:
            if not isinstance(c, dict):
                continue
            if c.get("snapshot_id") != snapshot_id:
                continue
            tnid = c.get("tree_node_id")
            if tnid:
                cnt_by_node[tnid] = c

        files_out = []
        for n in sorted(file_nodes, key=lambda x: (x.get("path") or "")):
            # maxFileSize filtering (metadata required; if unknown size_bytes, must not include content in offline mode)
            sz = n.get("size_bytes")
            if isinstance(sz, int) and maxFileSize is not None and sz > maxFileSize:
                continue
            if sz is None and maxFileSize is not None:
                # would need to fetch metadata; offline => exclude to satisfy rule
                continue

            c = cnt_by_node.get(n.get("id"))
            if not c:
                continue

            enc = c.get("encoding")
            if enc not in ("utf-8", "base64", "binary"):
                continue

            # bytes
            bl = c.get("byte_length")
            if not isinstance(bl, int) or bl < 0:
                continue
            if maxFileSize is not None and bl > maxFileSize:
                continue

            # tokens
            est = c.get("estimated_tokens")
            if isinstance(est, int) and est >= 0:
                needed_tokens = est
            else:
                if enc == "utf-8":
                    needed_tokens = _estimate_tokens_from_text(c.get("content_text") or "")
                else:
                    # base64/binary token cost is approximated by byte_length/4
                    needed_tokens = max(1, (bl + 3) // 4)

            if tokens_included + needed_tokens > maxTokens:
                break

            # binary handling: never emit content_text for binary
            out_content_text = None
            out_content_base64 = None
            if enc == "utf-8":
                # if node says binary, do not emit text (omit)
                if n.get("is_binary") is True:
                    # omit file entry entirely (allowed by rule)
                    continue
                out_content_text = c.get("content_text")
                if out_content_text is None:
                    continue
            elif enc == "base64":
                out_content_base64 = c.get("content_base64")
                if out_content_base64 is None:
                    continue
            else:  # binary
                # omit (allowed); alternatively could return base64 but none stored
                continue

            file_entry = {
                "tree_node_id": n.get("id"),
                "path": n.get("path"),
                "name": n.get("name"),
                "extension": n.get("extension"),
                "size_bytes": n.get("size_bytes"),
                "blob_sha": n.get("blob_sha"),
                "encoding": enc,
                "byte_length": bl,
                "estimated_tokens": needed_tokens,
                "content_text": out_content_text,
                "content_base64": out_content_base64,
                "fetched_at": c.get("fetched_at"),
            }
            files_out.append(file_entry)
            files_included += 1
            bytes_included += bl
            tokens_included += needed_tokens

    # ---------- finalize query row ----------
    query_row["status"] = "completed"
    query_row["result_tree_nodes"] = 0 if omitTree else len(tree_out or [])
    query_row["result_files_included"] = 0 if omitFiles else (len(files_out or []))
    query_row["result_bytes_included"] = 0 if omitFiles else bytes_included
    query_row["result_estimated_tokens"] = 0 if omitFiles else tokens_included
    query_row["updated_at"] = now
    _save("content_queries.json", queries)

    _append_audit(200, "completed", repository_id=repository_id, snapshot_id=snapshot_id, query_id=query_id)

    return {
        "repository": {
            "id": repository_id,
            "owner": repo_row.get("owner"),
            "name": repo_row.get("name"),
            "html_url": repo_row.get("html_url"),
            "default_branch": repo_row.get("default_branch"),
            "visibility": repo_row.get("visibility"),
            "status": repo_row.get("status"),
        },
        "snapshot": {
            "id": snapshot_id,
            "branch": snapshot_row.get("branch"),
            "head_sha": snapshot_row.get("head_sha"),
            "status": snapshot_row.get("status"),
            "source": snapshot_row.get("source"),
            "tree_root_path": snapshot_row.get("tree_root_path"),
            "created_at": snapshot_row.get("created_at"),
            "updated_at": snapshot_row.get("updated_at"),
        } if snapshot_row else None,
        "query": {
            "id": query_id,
            "status": query_row.get("status"),
            "effectiveBranch": effective_branch,
            "omitFiles": bool(omitFiles),
            "omitTree": bool(omitTree),
            "maxFileSize": maxFileSize,
            "maxTokens": maxTokens,
        },
        "tree": tree_out if not omitTree else None,
        "files": files_out if not omitFiles else None,
        "meta": {
            "tree_nodes_included": query_row.get("result_tree_nodes") or 0,
            "files_included": query_row.get("result_files_included") or 0,
            "bytes_included": query_row.get("result_bytes_included") or 0,
            "estimated_tokens_included": query_row.get("result_estimated_tokens") or 0,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
        }
    }

tool_schemas.name: listRepositories
tool_schemas.description: Lists normalized repositories known to the service, with optional filtering by owner/name/visibility and lifecycle status; returns a paginated result set and refuses invalid filters.

owner.description: Filter by GitHub repository owner (exact match)

tool_schemas.name: getRepository
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single repository record by id; returns the repository and refuses if the id does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: updateRepository
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a repository, including lifecycle status transitions (active/disabled/deleted); refuses invalid transitions or attempts to serve deleted repositories.

status.description: New repository status; must follow lifecycle transitions

defaultBranch.description: Default branch name to use when branch is omitted

tool_schemas.name: listRepoSnapshots
tool_schemas.description: Lists repository snapshots for a repository and optional branch/status filters; returns a paginated result set and refuses invalid filters.

repositoryId.description: Repository id to list snapshots for

headSha.description: Filter by head commit SHA (exact match)

source.description: Filter by snapshot source (implementation may map to these values)

tool_schemas.name: createRepoSnapshot
tool_schemas.description: Creates (queues) a new repository snapshot build for the given repository and branch (or reuses an existing ready snapshot when possible); returns the snapshot record and refuses if the repository is disabled/deleted or inputs are invalid.

branch.description: Branch name to snapshot; if omitted, resolves to repository default branch and then main/master

headSha.description: Optional explicit head SHA; when omitted, resolves against GitHub for the branch

forceRebuild.description: If true, forces a new queued snapshot even if a ready snapshot exists for the same branch/headSha
